critical_rule.rationale: Even if Pilot A and C have high Executor counts, Pilot B independently requires E>=1. Aggregate counting is prohibited.
critical_rule.aggregate_mask_check: If Pilot B E=0 and aggregate E>=4, Pilot B STILL FAILS.

independent_evaluation.note: Pilot B is evaluated ONLY on its own DB (pilot-b/harness.db). Other pilot counts do not compensate for Pilot B deficiencies. E=0 means FAIL even if total aggregate Executor count is high.
